Class AppointmentService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucalgary.oop.AppointmentService

      public Appointment scheduleAppointment(Pet pet, Veterinarian veterinarian, LocalDateTime dateTime, String notes) throws AppointmentSchedulingException

      Parameters:
      pet - pet being seen
      veterinarian - assigned veterinarian
      dateTime - appointment date/time
      notes - appointment notes
      Returns:
      newly created appointment
